# Manillen project instructions

- Read [README.md](../README.md) before making a change; use it as the project overview and check the current source/configuration when details may have changed.
- Make focused changes that follow the existing Shiny for Python and file-based data patterns. Preserve compatibility between the writable NAS app and the public read-only mirror.
- Treat `data/` as persistent user data. Do not overwrite or delete existing records as part of startup, publishing, or test setup.
- Keep credentials out of source, UI, and logs. Do not expose private NAS data in the public mirror.
- Validate changes with the smallest relevant existing check. If no relevant automated test exists, report what was inspected or exercised.
- Update `README.md` in the same change whenever significant behavior, architecture, data formats, publishing, or deployment changes. Keep the README aligned with the implementation.
- `docs/` is generated by `publish_mirror.py`; update its source files and regenerate the export instead of hand-editing generated output.
